component: Thunderbird granular OAuth scope browser test

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The one-line landing resets remembered OAuth objects between deleting saved logins and resetting FOG at subtest start. The helper clears token-bearing remembered objects; accepted code later repeats that setup inside its authorization retry loop. This separates scenario state from saved logins and telemetry, without establishing that the intermittent failure was cured.
title: The granular-scope test resets remembered OAuth objects before each original scenario
